fields.meta_title: Karaoke Sign Up Sheet With a Fair Singer Queue | Emergent
fields.meta_description: Build a karaoke sign up sheet that holds repeat singers for the next rotation, asks for a new pick when a song is taken, and opens a waitlist.
fields.h1: Build a Karaoke Sign-Up Sheet That Keeps the Queue Fair
fields.hero_description: Build a karaoke sign up sheet singers fill in from their phones, with one song each per rotation and the queue on screen.
fields.features_heading: What the Sheet Handles While the Mic Is Busy
fields.features_subheading: A karaoke sign up sheet is the running order for the night. Describe the night, and Emergent builds a sheet that keeps that order.
fields.feature_1:
Sign-ups sized for a phone screen

Shows the singer one question at a time, from a name or stage name through to the song. A guest who opens the link at a bar table never has to zoom in on a tiny grid.
fields.feature_2:
A rotation that gives everyone a turn

Gives each singer one song per rotation. A second sign-up from someone already in the current round is held for the next one. Regulars wait their turn like everyone else.
fields.feature_3:
The queue on a screen by the stage

Shows the next five singers on a screen the whole room can see, updated as each name comes in. Singers stop walking up to the host to ask how many people are ahead of them.
fields.feature_4:
A second choice when a song is taken

Checks each song against the night's queue. If another singer already has it, the form asks for a second choice before saving, and no ballad gets sung twice in one night.
fields.feature_5:
Duet partners and notes for the host

Adds a line for a duet partner and a note for the host, such as a key change. The partner's name sits on the song's row, and the host calls both singers up to sing together.
fields.feature_6:
Your singer list, your code

Keeps every night's sign-ups in a database you own, so a list of regulars builds up week by week. On paid plans, export the full code of the sheet to your GitHub repository.

fields.usecase_heading: What the Sheet Did on Four Karaoke Nights
fields.tab_content_1:
Cyprian's encore waits for rotation 3 to start

Winifred Vardakis hosts Thursday karaoke at the Brasswell Tavern, and her sheet allows one song per singer in each rotation. Rotation 2 has 14 singers. Cyprian Duvalle already has a song in rotation 2. When he signs up for a second one, it is held for rotation 3. The screen by the stage shows Clementina Oyediran up next.
fields.tab_content_2:
Danny Boy is spoken for, and Fabian picks again

Marcellus Tindall runs the Haverstock Freight holiday party, and 26 coworkers sign up to sing. Cosmina Pellinore claims Danny Boy first. When Fabian Wexmoor picks the same song, the form tells him it is taken and asks for a second choice. He picks Shenandoah instead.
fields.tab_content_3:
Three judges score, and 27 of 30 leads

The Strickmore Middle School fundraiser contest has 12 singers, each with a song and a homeroom. Three judges score every singer out of 10 on their phones, and the app ranks the totals as scores come in. Thelonius Fairbrass leads with 27 of 30 after scores of 9, 10, and 8.
fields.tab_content_4:
When all 18 slots fill, slot 19 joins a waitlist

Horatio Lamplugh turns 40 and books a 90-minute karaoke set, which fits 18 songs at 5 minutes each. Guests sign up from the link on his invitation. Once all 18 slots are taken, Aloysius Tregarthen signs up and becomes number 1 on the waitlist. Horatio gets an email that the sheet is full.

fields.howto_title: How to Make a Karaoke Sign-Up Sheet
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to make a karaoke sign up sheet that keeps the singer queue fair, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Work out how long the set runs
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Ask only for what the host reads
fields.howto_step_1_des: Start from the clock, not the sign-ups. Allow about 5 minutes per singer, counting the walk to the mic and the change between tracks. A 3-hour night fits 36 turns, which tells you how many slots to open.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask for a name or stage name, the song, the artist, and any note the host needs. Stop there. Every extra question is one more thing a singer has to type at a loud table with a drink in the other hand.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide how turns are shared before the first name goes in. A single song for each person per round is the easiest rule to explain. Anyone who signs up twice waits for the next round, and nobody argues about it at the mic.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose whether two people may sing the same song in one night. At a contest, a repeat invites side-by-side comparisons. At a bar, it can drag. If you block repeats, have the form ask for a second choice up front.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Put the fields and both rules into one plain-English prompt, along with who hears when the set fills. Emergent builds the form, the queue screen, and the database. To add a duet line later, ask for it in another prompt.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Put the link where people sit
fields.howto_step_6_des: Print the sign-up link as a QR code on table cards and by the bar, and show it on the screen between songs. At a private party, add the link to the invitation and let guests pick their songs before they arrive.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Run a test round before doors open
fields.howto_step_7_des: Enter four test singers, then sign one of them up again and try a song that is already taken. Check that the second song lands in the next rotation and that the form asks for another pick. Delete the test rows.

faq_plan.q: What is a karaoke sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: A karaoke sign up sheet is the list a host runs the night from. Each line holds a singer's name and song, and the order of the lines decides who goes next. It can be a clipboard by the stage or a phone form that feeds a queue.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a karaoke sign up sheet?
faq_plan.a: Describe the night in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder: the fields, the rotation rule, and what happens when a song is taken or the set fills. Emergent builds the form and its database. Share the link, run a test round, then open it to singers.

faq_plan.q: How many singers can a karaoke sign up sheet hold in an hour?
faq_plan.a: About 12, if you allow 5 minutes a turn. Those 5 minutes cover the song plus the handover between singers. If your crowd leans toward long ballads, budget 6 minutes a turn and open 10 slots an hour instead.

faq_plan.q: Can I reuse the same karaoke sign up sheet every week?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Keep one link and clear the queue at closing, and the sheet starts empty the next week. Emergent keeps past nights in a database you own, where you can see which singers come back. For a group that also tracks members and meeting duties, a club sign up sheet fits better.

faq_plan.q: How does a karaoke sign up sheet stop one person hogging the mic?
faq_plan.a: It limits each person to one song in each round. A repeat sign-up waits until the round ends. Post the limit on the screen before the first song, and the host never has to turn anyone down in person.

faq_plan.q: Can singers fill in a karaoke sign up sheet on their phones?
faq_plan.a: Yes. They open the sign-up link, either typed in or scanned from a code on the table, and enter a name and a song on a short form. Keep it to four questions at most: name, song, artist, and a note. Each entry joins the queue as soon as it is saved, and the host stops collecting paper slips.

faq_plan.q: Can a karaoke sign up sheet also collect food for a party?
faq_plan.a: Yes, though it reads better as its own section, so a song pick never waits on a dish choice. For a party where guests bring food, a potluck sign up sheet tracks who brings what by course. Emergent builds either one from a plain-English prompt.

faq_plan.q: How should a karaoke sign up sheet work for a contest?
faq_plan.a: It should hold each singer's scores next to the song. Use the same judges and the same scale for every singer, such as 1 to 10, and agree on what earns a 10 before the first song. Decide in advance how a tie is broken, such as a short sing-off.

faq_plan.q: What happens when a karaoke sign up sheet is full?
faq_plan.a: Later sign-ups go on a numbered waitlist, and the host calls them in order if a singer leaves or the set runs long. Tell each waitlisted singer their number. With Emergent, no cap limits sign-ups; the only limit is the slot count you choose.

faq_plan.q: Is a karaoke sign up sheet the same as a sign in sheet?
faq_plan.a: No. A sign up sheet books a turn that has not happened yet, while a sign in sheet records who has already arrived. If you need a record of everyone on a work site and when they came in, a safety sign in sheet does that job.

The FAQ covers what to put on the sheet, fair rotation, set length, repeat songs, phone sign-up and contests.
